messages:
maria: Quick async triage — ACMEHealth private rollout. Need to confirm owners for VPN tunnel troubleshooting and cert rotation. Current blockers: egress firewall CIDR mismatch + airgap image sync failing.

ajenkins: I can own the VPN tunnel side. Will need firewall ACLs from @chiara and a contact at the customer for BGP details.

chiara: I can take firewall ACLs. Will open a PR to infra-firewall and add test harness. ETA today noon PST. Ping me exact CIDRs.

sidd: Image sync is failing on the on-prem registrar — getting 403s during manifest pull. Logs show SAML auth error. @kevin_r can you check registry token rotation?

kevin_r: On it. I saw a rotation job error at 03:12 UTC. Re-running refresh now and will post logs. Also adding a temp bypass rule for the sync path (will revert after).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary runs passing for dedicated-capacity v2.3.1 on staging (run id: 6789).

maria: Owners list so far: VPN -> @ajenkins, Firewall -> @chiara, Registry/token -> @kevin_r. Action items: AJ open ticket referencing customer network notes, Chiara open PR, Kevin re-run token + post logs. I will coordinate PM/CS handoff.

ajenkins: Ticket INF-4321 created and assigned to me. Added notes about BGP flaps and peer ASN mismatch. Customer netops contact added: netops@acmehealth.com

chiara: PR is up: https://git.redwood/infra/firewall/pulls/289 — includes ACLs and a local test harness. Requesting review from @sidd.

sidd: Reviewing the PR now. For airgap image sync, if the registry remains blocked we should have a scripted tarball fallback to import images manually.

kevin_r: Token refresh succeeded. Logs: ```POST /auth/refresh 200; new_token_expiry=168h``` Re-triggered image sync, currently at 45%.

maria: :thumbsup: Two scheduling risks: customer's cert rotation window overlaps with their maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 PST and they have a change freeze starting 01:00. Avoid the freeze.

ajenkins: Acknowledged. I'll shift our tunnel restart to 04:10 PST and set canary window to 04:30.

chiara: If registry doesn't finish by 03:30 we'll fallback to manual image import checklist. I'll prep the checklist and owners for handoff.

sidd: Also a reminder to update the rollback playbook with explicit step to revert KV cache changes — playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/infer/rollback

maria: I'll consolidate everything into one doc and ping PM/CS. Anyone else who needs to step in? Planning to close this async triage in 1 hour unless new blockers show.

kevin_r: Updating INF-4321 with logs and progress. If sync reaches 90% I'll mark green.

ajenkins: Update 04:05 UTC: VPN tunnel re-established with correct peer ASN. Monitoring for stability.

deploy-bot: Incident tracker: INF-4321 status=investigating -> monitoring

maria: Thanks all — will close after green. /cc @pm-elaine @cs-aaron
